newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile gov't prepares bill to reduce tariffs.
newsitem.headline: Chile gov't prepares bill to reduce tariffs.

text.p: The Chilean government will send a bill to Congress to reduce the country's uniform import duty to eight percent from 11 percent currently in the next few weeks, Finance Minister Eduardo Aninat said.
Speaking in Congress, Aninat said technical studies on the reduction of the duty were finished and that the executive branch was now nearly ready to send the bill to Congress.
He said the government was sorry for the delay in drafting the bill, which some business leaders have been demanding for months.
"We apologize for these weeks of delay but the government repeats its willingness to reduce tariffs," Aninat said in a speech to the Senate.
The reduction by three percentage points will be proposed by the government in the next few weeks, he said.
Aninat was speaking in the Senate during final speeches before the vote on the ratification of a free trade agreement with Canada.
